description: HOLLAND, MI – Michigan families are getting hammered at the pump, but Sean McCann and Lansing Democrats just went home without lifting a finger to suspend Michigan’s 52-cent-per-gallon gas tax. The Michigan Senate was in session Thursday as lawmakers in both parties called for suspending the gas tax. But McCann and Senate Democrats left Lansing without even taking a vote.…
